chunks: So he threw it down, and lo, it became a running serpent.
ai.seo_question: What happened when Musa threw his staff in Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Taa-Haa, this verse highlights the tangible manifestation of divine authority (Hujjah) against Pharaoh's magicians, emphasizing that Musa's staff became a 'living creature' (Hayyah) by God's leave. Shia exegesis often interprets this transformation as a precursor to the ultimate victory of truth over falsehood, underscoring the miraculous nature of the Prophet's sign as a direct challenge to earthly power.
